history.summary: plan.md completed as localized: three phases against ../HelmCharts — P1 stands up the gate the repo lacks (pytest dev group + .kubecoder/project.yaml, no config.yaml, per the ruling), P2 lands the reconciler: ownership key (R1+R2+R3 plus the ruling's widened refusal set), P3 fixes the latent get_chart_args fall-through. verification.json carries 15 outcome-level criteria, 1:1 against slice.md's three requirements plus each ruling. A research sub-agent discharged the 'prove no breakage' ruling: R1 is the cure — unallowlisted keys make `deploy config` exit 1, and gen_architecture calls it for every prd stage one line before its falsy-chart skip, so `config` must never join the refusal set; audit-prd-orphans and recommend-resources never call the CLI and are unaffected. Two out-of-scope findings recorded in close-out.md.

Structure, AC completeness, task shape, targets and phase boundaries are sound; three operator decisions remain — V08's no-breakage promise holds only for a local-chart entry carrying `chart: null` (an entry omitting `chart:` or using design.md's `upstream: {repo,chart,version}` shape still exits `deploy config` non-zero and takes down gen-architecture), the derived typo guard reintroduces that same fatal exit without its cost stated, and `refresh-secrets` is filed as an inspection verb although it annotates and rollout-restarts the namespace.

Applied every round-1 ruling the plan did not yet reflect: P2 now short-circuits release resolution for a non-jenkins entry (no chart-existence check, no upstream: validation, _UPSTREAM_KEYS untouched) so the no-breakage guarantee holds for any registry entry shape, the refusal set is the eight verbs including refresh-secrets against the four read-only inspection verbs, and the unrecognised-reconciler guard is struck with its accepted cost recorded. P1 states the gate-durability limitation instead of claiming 011/012 inherit the gate, counts and citations are corrected (51 stage dirs, gen_architecture:578-580, resolve_helm_args:35), and verification.json reworded V01, narrowed V05, widened V08, struck V11, rewrote V15 and added V16/V17. run_loop.py --dry-run parses all three phases; committed.
